locator: Motorlu Kara Taşıtı Ticareti; 27.08.2024 effective regulation summary
observations: The Motor Vehicle Trade Regulation entered into force through Official Gazette 32645 on 27 August 2024.
Its scope includes authorised traders, secure payment, advertisements and expert reports.
limitations: Applicability depends on seller status, vehicle and transaction facts; the current consolidated text controls.
